findings.why_it_matters: Its siblings 3.2 and 3.4 through 3.8 in the same chapter are '##' headings (e.g. '## 3.2 THE FILE DESCRIPTION ENTRY' on page 396, '## 3.4 THE CODE-SET CLAUSE' on page 398), and their subclauses are '###'; 3.3 is one level lower and its subclauses ('#### 3.3.1 Function') two levels below 3.4.1, so the outline nests 3.3 under 3.2.
